name: Turquoise Parrot
rangeDescription: Southeastern australia (southeastern queensland to northern victoria)
description: Brightly colored small parrot with yellow underbelly, green back, and a blue face and shoulder patch. Adult male has entirely blue face; female and juvenile have reduced blue.

name: Yellow-throated Longclaw
rangeDescription: Widespread grassland of sub-saharan africa
description: A large pipit-like bird with golden-yellow underparts and eyebrow, and a circular broad black necklace emphasizing the yellow throat. The upperparts are subdued streaky brown and the outer tail corners are white, which is a key feature in flight.

name: Blue-capped Puffleg
rangeDescription: Andes of southern bolivia and northwestern argentina
description: Generally rare (but locally fairly common in a few spots) hummingbird of humid forests just below treeline on the eastern slope of the Andes from NW Argentina to La Paz, Bolivia. Often feeds near treefalls and roadcuts, especially on bellflowers (Lobelioideae).

name: Berlepsch's Tinamou
rangeDescription: Tropical forest of northwestern colombia to northwestern ecuador
description: A very dark, chicken-like bird found in lowland rainforest in northwestern Ecuador and western Colombia. Plumage is dark gray, but can appear almost black in the shady rainforest understory.

name: Indian Pond-Heron
rangeDescription: Persian gulf to india, myanmar, and andaman and nicobar islands
description: A small heron that is common in most aquatic habitats across the Indian subcontinent. Adults in breeding plumage have a dark reddish brown back that contrasts with a yellowish head, neck, and breast.

name: Amazonian Grosbeak
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia (northward at least to western meta) to southern and northeastern venezuela (northward to sucre) eastward to the guianas, and southward through amazonia to central bolivia (western and northern santa cruz)
description: Chunky, stout-billed bird of humid evergreen forest and edge in tropical lowlands. Occurs from throughout much of the Amazon basin (east of the Andes).

name: Vogelkop Scrubwren
rangeDescription: Western new guinea (arfak and tamrau mountains and bomberai peninsula)
description: A very small, drab bird of montane forest understory on the Bird’s Head of New Guinea. Dull to warm brown upperparts, pale brown underparts and a thick, pale eye-ring.

name: Chestnut-capped Thrush
rangeDescription: Thai-malay peninsula, sumatra, java, borneo, southwestern philippines (sulu archipelago), and lesser sundas (lombok, sumbawa, and flores)
description: Shy and seldom-seen jewel of a thrush. Note dark chestnut hood, gray back, and sharply-patterned black-and-white wing patches.

name: Ring-necked Duck
rangeDescription: Breeds alaska to southern usa; winters to panama and southern lesser antilles
description: A relatively small diving duck with a tall peaked crown. Males are handsome with glossy black head and back, clean gray sides, and a brighter white spur on the side.

name: Golden-crowned Babbler
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (sierra madre mountains of northern luzon)
description: A fairly small bird of lowland and foothill forest, open wooded areas with developed understory, bamboo, and tall grass. Has a gray back and cheek with fine pale streaks, dark wings and tail with white outer tail feathers, white underparts, and a yellow throat and crown.

name: Horned Coot
rangeDescription: High andean lakes of southwestern bolivia to northern chile and northwestern argentina
description: Very large, but rather local coot; rare except at a few lakes in the high Andes set amid barren and rocky surroundings. Often far out on deep-water lakes, where it looks rather uneventful: black overall with a pale yellowish bill.

name: Dusky-green Oropendola
rangeDescription: Andes of southeastern peru and northwestern to central bolivia (la paz to western santa cruz)
description: Medium-sized oropendola of montane forests. Evenly olive-green, with a dark eye and pale bill.

name: Taiwan Scimitar-Babbler
rangeDescription: Taiwan
description: Medium-sized, strikingly patterned songbird endemic to Taiwan, where fairly common. Brown above, white below, with white supercilium, black mask, and heavy black spots on the breast.

name: Snowy Albatross
rangeDescription: Southern oceans in south georgia area
description: Huge albatross of the Southern Ocean; the southernmost breeder of the Wandering Albatross complex (including Snowy, Tristan, Antipodean, and Amsterdam albatrosses). Main colonies on South Georgia in the South Atlantic, and various islands in the southern Indian Ocean, but ranges extensively at sea.

name: Falcated Duck
rangeDescription: Breeds mongolia, eastern siberia, and northeastern china; winters northern india to southern and eastern china, southern korean peninsula, and japan
description: An East Asian teal-like duck. Males are distinctive, with an iridescent head that flashes green and copper, a silvery body with distinct scalloping, extremely long curved tertials, long pale scapulars, and a triangular white throat patch outlined in dark green.

name: Speckle-breasted Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Far southeastern nigeria eastward to southwestern south sudan, northeastern democratic republic of the congo, uganda, northern rwanda, and western kenya
description: Small, rather pale greenish woodpecker. The underparts are mostly plain yellowish, with fine spotting on the breast.

name: Purple-breasted Cotinga
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southern venezuela, the guianas, and northern and eastern amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized bird of rainforest canopy. Male unmistakable if seen in good light; female is conspicuously scalloped all over.

name: Peruvian Antpitta
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of southeastern ecuador and far northern peru
description: Small, very rare antpitta of Andean cloud forest understory. Despite its name, most sightings are from the east slope of the Andes in Ecuador.

name: Halmahera Flowerpecker
rangeDescription: Moluccas (morotai, halmahera, kasiruta, bacan, obi, and bisa)
description: A tiny, dumpy, very short-tailed gray songbird. Paler underparts are divided by a whiter central strip.

name: Tagula Shrikethrush
rangeDescription: Tagula (louisiade archipelago, off southeastern new guinea)
description: Learn about Little Shrikethrush (Tagula): explore photos, sounds, and observations collected by birders around the world.
